meta.source: All India Pincode Directory, Department of Posts (GODL-India), via github.com/dropdevrahul/pincodes-india
meta.method: Per pin: drop points outside Karnataka bounds, take median of post-office coordinates, drop offices >8 km from that median, re-take median. Confidence: high = 3+ offices within 4 km; medium = 2 offices; low = 1 office or >60 km from city centre. Two pins manually overridden. Pins with city-only prefixes (560, 570) lying >35 km from centre are set to unknown. Existing-store pins checked by hand.
meta.guardrail: When confidence is low or none, the engine must NOT block on distance; apply only the same-pin rule and say so.
